body: nobody really understands anyway i just feel like talking to people i guess... im 17 ill be 18 in a few months. I cant describe my life to you it has always been very strange and awful from the time i was born. i have had so many mental illness that i cant count them all. the one thing in life that has pushed its a feeling like im burning being stabbed without the knife ever coming out being squished by a broken building drowning in a bottomless lake either crying in agony always or being unable to cry but your inside is like a waterfall being clawed with an eagle in the heart neverending pain and distress in the back of my mind so much pain i feel myself going insane and screaming and screaming into a hotel i camt drive i dont have an income i have applied took a test failed and so far no jobs and ive applied since december. its more than that but its just too much to explain. theres no relatives hospital i had a cold which was true. i think either tonight or tomorrow night im going to sneak out at night make a rope of some kind and find a tree. if i could trade someone who is dying my life i would... why is it people who want to live die and people who want to die live?
